{"code": "
import json, re
recs = json.load(open("/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/output_work/records.json"))
by = {}
for r in recs:
    by.setdefault(r.get('Portfolio key'), []).append(r)

def clean(b):
    b = (b or '')
    for cut in ['RELIANCE LIMITS','SCHEDULE 1','SCHEDULE 2','The matter-level control is']:
        i = b.find(cut)
        if i>0: b = b[:i]
    b = re.sub(r'\s+',' ', b).strip()
    return b

SUBJ = {
 'CBP-031-01':'Bates-Range Overlap','CBP-031-02':'Email-Family Separation','CBP-031-03':'Request-Response Mismatch',
 'CBP-031-04':'Metadata Field Loss','CBP-031-05':'Collection-Date Inconsistency','CBP-031-06':'Protective-Order Designation Error',
 'CBP-031-07':'Production Gap','CBP-031-08':'Legal-Hold Delivery Gap','CBP-031-09':'Clawback Deadline',
 'CBP-031-10':'Third-Party Subpoena Deadline','CBP-031-11':'Custodian Omission','CBP-031-12':'Common-Interest Support Gap'}

keys = sorted(by.keys())
lines = []
for k in keys:
    rs = {r.get('Evidence role'): r for r in by[k]}
    ident = clean(rs.get('identity_crosswalk',{}).get('body'))
    oper  = clean(rs.get('operative_authority',{}).get('body'))
    cur   = clean(rs.get('current_operations',{}).get('body'))
    appr  = clean(rs.get('approval_and_capacity',{}).get('body'))
    corr  = clean(rs.get('correspondence',{}).get('body'))
    lines.append("### %s (%s)\n  IDENT: %s\n  OPER: %s\n  CURR: %s\n  APPR: %s\n  CORR: %s" % (k, SUBJ.get(k,''), ident, oper, cur, appr, corr))

out = "\n".join(lines)
open("/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/output_work/analysis.txt","w").write(out)
print(out)
"}
